thread:
maya: Heads-up — starting a staggered rollout for embed-service v2 in ~10m (change window 23:00-00:30 UTC). Watchlist: p95 latency, 5xx rate, kv-cache miss rate. I’ll post dashboards and the canary plan.

sam: thanks — which dashboards? can you paste links?

maya: panels: infra.embed-service.p95, infra.embed-service.5xx_rate, infra.embed-service.kvcache_miss, traces: /embed/infer. Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/xyz/embed-service-overview

neha: adding runbook snippet here — rollback criteria we agreed: 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 > 300ms for 10m OR error-budget-burn-rate > 4x. Roll-forward if canary p95 <= 120ms and 5xx < 0.5% for 15m.

raj: noted. Can we pin canary at 10% traffic for 20 minutes, then 50% for 15m, then full? Also request to pin model version in the route: model=embed-v2-2026-03-15 to avoid auto-variant routing.

maya: yep: plan is 10%/20m -> 50%/15m -> 100%/10m. Pinning the route now: config snippet: 
```
route: /embed
model_version: "embed-v2-2026-03-15"
traffic: canary
canary_steps: [10, 50, 100]
```

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by maya. Canary start time 1765123456. Canary group: eu-west-1-a.

ops-bot: Canary verification: integrations ok. Health checks green.

sam: I’ll watch logs for error signatures (RateLimitExceeded / KVCacheMiss spikes). If we see KV cache miss > 12% at canary, we should consider reducing traffic and enabling warm-up.

neha: good call — warming note: cache prewarm job queued (job-id: warm-1765). If miss spikes, run: `./tools/cache_prewarm --target=eu-west-1 --model=embed-v2-2026-03-15`

maya: canary traffic now at 10% — linking spike queries for quick triage: 
- 5xx query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embed",status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embed"}[1m]))`
- p95 query: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="embed"}[5m])) by (le))`

raj: I see a small p95 bump to 140ms but 5xx still 0.2%. keep an eye for sustained > 3 points.

sam: alert firing? nothing yet on main SLO dashboard. I’ve set a temporary watch alert: `alert: embed_canary_p95_warn` threshold 250ms for 5m.

maya: move to 50% in 5m if no alerts. Anyone object?

neha: go ahead. I’ll keep a console open and post snapshots every 5m.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 50% at 1765123600.

ops-bot: Observability snapshot attached (summary): p95=130ms, 5xx=0.18%, kv-cache-miss=7.2%.

sam: looks stable. No error patterns in traces. Holding for 15m per plan.

maya: setting rollout timer. If anything crosses rollback threshold I’ll pause and call a quick huddle here. Please react with :thumbsup: if you’re watching.

neha: :thumbsup:

raj: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Canary health check at 1765123690: all primary metrics nominal. No automated rollback.

maya: rolling to 100% now. Release notes: "embed-service v2 — improved recall & 2x throughput; model embed-v2-2026-03-15; kv-cache prewarm enabled; updated route pinning." I’ll follow up with a short postmortem template if anything odd emerges.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete at 1765123696.

maya: thanks team. Closing watch in 30m unless anyone wants to keep it open.
